name: Contemporary
tagline: Sleek, current, polished, fluid and elevated
description: Contemporary design reflects the present moment, blending clean lines, open spaces, and a sophisticated mix of materials. Neutral palettes are layered with subtle contrasts, while glass, metal, and natural textures create depth. The result is a polished, ever-adapting aesthetic that feels fresh and effortlessly modern.

name: Minimalist
description: Minimalist interiors strip away excess so light, proportion, and material quality can lead. Open plans, hidden storage, and a restrained palette create calm Dubai living without feeling cold — every piece earns its place.

name: Neoclassical
description: Neoclassical interiors bring symmetry, moulding, and refined ornament into modern villas. Marble, brass, and tailored upholstery create a formal yet livable luxury that photographs beautifully and ages well.

name: Mediterranean
description: Mediterranean rooms lean on terracotta, arches, plaster, and abundant natural light. Ideal for waterfront apartments and garden villas, the style feels holiday-ready year round without sacrificing durability.

name: Japandi
description: Japandi mixes Japanese restraint with Scandinavian warmth — pale woods, low furniture, and tactile textiles. It is a favourite for apartments that need to feel larger, quieter, and more considered.

name: Arabian
description: Arabian interiors honour craft, pattern, and hospitality. Mashrabiya screens, carved joinery, and rich textiles are executed with contemporary proportions so the home feels rooted and current at once.

name: Farmhouse
description: Farmhouse living brings timber, stone, and comfortable seating into Dubai villas. Open kitchens, generous islands, and tactile finishes make family spaces that feel collected rather than staged.

name: Industrial
description: Industrial interiors celebrate concrete, metal, and exposed structure. Perfect for lofts, offices, and F&B, the look is balanced with warm lighting and custom joinery so it stays liveable, not unfinished.

name: Ultra Luxury
description: Ultra luxury is bespoke at every layer — stone, metalwork, lighting, and millwork designed as one composition. We execute palatial villas and penthouses with museum-level detailing and discreet technology.

name: Boho Chic
description: Boho chic layers textiles, colour, and collected objects over a calm architectural base. We keep the bones clean so the look can evolve, while joinery and lighting hold the composition together.

name: Wellness
description: Wellness interiors prioritise air quality, biophilic materials, acoustic comfort, and circadian lighting. Ideal after a full renovation — healthier rooms that still look like a designed home, not a clinic.
